'''Ratliff''' is a historical figure from an unknown Age.
== Activities ==
[[Birgitte Silverbow]] uses "Ratliff's nails" as an exclamation during the [[Last Battle]].{{ref/book|14|40}}
==Trivia==
Ratliff is named for Jack Ratliff, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
